title: Effect of Inclisiran on LDL-C Levels and Coronary Plaque Burden Assessed by Ultra-High Resolution Photon-Counting CT Angiography
official: Effect of Inclisiran on LDL-C Levels and Coronary Plaque Burden Assessed by Ultra-High Resolution Photon-Counting CT Angiography
summary: Main objective: To evaluate, the effect of Inclisiran on LDL-C concentrations after 12 months of treatment with Inclisiran on top to combination ezetimibe/statin therapy
conditions: Chronic coronary syndrome (CCS)/ history of myocardial infarction (MI) or very high risk of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participants are eligible to be included in the study only if all the following criteria apply: -	Participant has provided informed consent -	Age 18 to  ≤80 years -	Angiographic evidence of coronary stenosis ≥20% or >50% with no significant hyperemic indexes (i.e. RFR, iFR, DFR) or FFR≥0.80 or no signs of inducible myocardial ischemia with non-invasive functional imaging testing -	Chronic coronary syndrome (CCS) or history of myocardial infarction (MI) (presumed type 1 event due to plaque rupture/erosion) and/or coronary revascularization by PCI  -	Glomerular filtration rate >30 ml/min//1.73 mq -	Criteria for Inclisiran use in clinical practice as per ESC guidelines: •	Stable (≥4 weeks) and maximally tolerated low-density lipoprotein cholesterol lowering therapies, including statins plus/minus ezetimibe. •	Proven intolerance to statin, as defined as follows: (i) inability to tolerate at least 2 statins of which one at the initial dose (rosuvastatin 5 mg/day, atorvastatin 10 mg/day, simvastatin 10 mg/day, lovastatin 20 mg/day, pravastatin 40 mg/day, fluvastatin 40 mg/ day) and a second statin at any dose; (ii) association with one or more adverse events related to statin use that are not tolerable or association with significant alterations in biomarkers (CPK >10 x ULN, performed in the absence of muscle exertion); (iii) symptoms resolution or marked improvement, normalization or marked reduction of biomarkers upon discontinuation/reduction of statin dose; (iv) symptomatology/ enhancement of biomarkers not attributable to other causes (interactions drug or known clinical conditions that may increase the risk of intolerance to statins such as hypothyrodism, disease muscular disorders or major increase in activity physical activity). •	LDL-C ≥ 70 mg/dL at main screening visit, based on national current reimbursement rules issued by the Italian Medicines Agency (AIFA). •	Willing to return for subcutaneous administration of Inclisiran by a healthcare provider at the initial visit, at 3 months and every 6 months thereafter.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Participants are excluded from the study if any of the following criteria apply: -	Acute coronary syndrome, stroke, peripheral arterial revascularization procedure due to atherosclerotic disease <4 weeks before screening visit -	Treatment with PCSK9 inhibitors (e.g. evolocumab, alirocumab) within the past 90 days. (We exclude patients in treatment with PCSK9 inhibitors within the past 90 days. But if for some reasons the patients stopped the treatment with PCSK9 inhibitors and 90 days have gone, we can consider the enrollment in our study, if patients present the other inclusion criteria) -	Heart failure NYHA class III or IV -	Active liver disease defined as any known current infectious, neoplastic, or metabolic pathology of the liver (active liver disease - participants who enter the Statin Optimization Period must have AST and ALT ≤3x ULN [as defined by local laboratory reference ranges] at the Statin Optimization Screening Visit to be allowed to continue in the Statin Optimization Period) -	Severe concomitant non-CV disease expected to reduce life expectancy to <5 years -	History of malignancy that required surgery, radiation therapy, and/or systemic therapy during the 3 years prior to the first study visit -	Pregnant or nursing (lactating) women (women of child-bearing potential, unless they are using effective methods of contraception during the course of the trial) -	Body mass index ≥ 40 kg/m2
